criteria: Plausible expected net health per full recipient/associated resource cost, considering omitted portfolio pathways.
Strength and transferability of causal evidence; uncertainty is neither an automatic null nor permission to call priors measured.
Donation-sensitive marginal capacity versus grants, reserves, public/clinical substitutes and bottlenecks.
Value of information achievable in a bounded additional beta, reusing shared clinical/financial evidence.
Mechanism and geographic diversity where merited, without artificial quotas or default preference for large/famous recipients.
method: Compared all25 current California alpha reports: summary, model/formula, central and sensitivity scope, counterfactual, missing inputs, funding and qualitative evidence. Reused accepted original-financial and primary evidence rather than repeating broad research or independently reaccepting each alpha. Conditional price references retain their exact report cost cohorts. Ranking is a qualitative decision judgment, not a statistically calibrated expected-value ranking. Live HRS funding page was rechecked; an OA budget PDF fetch failed, so no new verification of that file is claimed beyond accepted evidence.

selected.reason: Donated specialty-care coordination has one of the strongest positive partial-health hypotheses and clear California eligibility. Current layoffs/funding-source loss make the donor-response question concrete, while a current budget and existing diagnosis-specific model make a bounded beta unusually tractable.
selected.mechanism: Clinical referral → completed indicated treatment → finite symptom/function or survival gain.
selected.donorMarginAssessment: Loss of a major funder coexists with 16 months of operating cash and replacement support; provider slots may bind before cash. No verified incremental offer.
selected.decisiveAuditQuestions: Identify the current service/diagnosis mix, not ten specialty labels. Reconcile the $1.9m 2026 operating plan with full recognized and donated clinical resources. Determine which extra coordinated patients can actually obtain provider slots beyond existing grants; audit alternative-care catch-up, repeat visits and low-value procedures.
selected.promotionDemotionTest: Promote if a plausibly donation-sensitive queue of high-benefit indicated treatment remains after full provider costs; demote if spare coordination cash cannot obtain slots or most credited cases receive equivalent timely care.

modelReference.scope: Full ordinary gift in donor numerator. All ten specialty allocations sum to one and include recipient program, management, fundraising and failed-referral work. Separate gross associated resource sensitivity includes all nominal services, not merely health-credited cases; no waived-charge multiplier. Prospective cash per-service costs are judgments anchored to 2025 recipient cash-like scale.
modelReference.warning: A disclosed partial-health scenario, not measured whole-portfolio expected value or a calibrated probability distribution. Prices across differing modeled cost/funding cohorts must not be averaged or used as the sole ranking.

selected.reason: A small, locally targeted recipient reaching high-risk people offers a plausible survival pathway with less geographic dilution than End Overdose and less large-contract complexity than HHCLA. selected.mechanism: Additional outreach/supplies → timely effective overdose response and care → finite survival.
selected.donorMarginAssessment: State free stock, other grants and responders continue. The 5,000 reach scale and 10% incremental hazard effect are judgments needing modern local evidence.
selected.decisiveAuditQuestions: Reconcile FY2025 inventory and donated supplies with grants, staff time and SSP expenses. Seek current unique opioid-risk reach, additional outreach hours and alternative-rescuer timing; stress recurrent overdose and competing mortality, using HEALing Communities as a counterweight rather than kits = lives.
selected.promotionDemotionTest: Promote if flexible outreach capacity demonstrably reaches otherwise-unprotected high-risk networks; demote if the margin mainly adds stock already freely available or uses duplicated/stale reach.

selected.promotionDemotionTest: Promote if an independently supported, donation-sensitive acceleration window exists; demote if the package is already funded/on schedule or only signage/awareness is being credited with engineering effects.
